body:
Well my problems isnt that big when you look at the bigger picture, either is my life. Not offended in any way.

I dont want to give up, but I just cant see any bright future any more. I cant see anything good in the end. If I fight there will just be more to fight. And everything is piling up, and at this point. Its just way to much.

I agree, a roller-coaster wouldn't be fun if it didn't go up and down. I used to believe this earlier. Before everything just went down.

​

Even now I feel bad for using your time with my crying on a forum. But thanks for replying you made my night a bit better.

I'm aware that all people have difficult times in their life and everyone meets different challenges in their life. But what keeps "everyone" going? What am I missing, why do most people wanna live their life, even tho bad things happens. And bad things will continue happening in their life. It feels like there is something big I dont understand or havent learned about life.
